experiments.scope: H1, H5 (proof.md Sections 5, 8, 9 and 13.3). Trials 0..5 run the counted online program on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 38-step compressions) until a first block has a passing class (at most 16 first blocks), processing one passing class (3840 good pairs, 15 bit-sliced batches): the stage-3a decision of every lane is compared with the scalar definition (E16x = C16 + W0 + s0(W1) from the Step-2 equations), every passing lane is extracted from the stored planes and compared with the class member, the hit list of all 90 W7 tests is compared with the definition of F7, and 8 good pairs are checked against every cell of rows -4..15. A trial returns the complete 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' of its first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 6..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 by design (the returned M0||M1 pairs are good pairs of rows -4..15, not collisions; rows 16..37 are not expected to hold). Mismatches: 0. Returned pairs: 6. Observations: first_blocks, w7_classes, classes_processed, good_pairs, prefilter_passes, row16_passes, counted_ops, units, filter_mismatches, cell_mismatches, lane_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked. A local emulation of the request returned 6 pairs with 0 mismatches of every kind. This tests the counted program, the bit-sliced decision of every lane (H5), the memory-free F7 test and the per-variant Step-2 equations on seeded first blocks (H1); it does not test q3.

experiments.scope: H2 (proof.md Sections 6.1, 7.3, 7.4 and 13.3): an organizer-executed replica of q3 for the accepted event (rows 16..21 with the four E19 patterns and the tie E20[29] = E19[29], equal outputs after step 37) with a pass rule frozen before its calibration. Trials 0..19 are 20 independent replicates of a sequential Monte-Carlo estimator seeded from SHAKE-256 of the trial seed: 64 particles uniform on the exact 32-word row-16 set; rows 17..21 with 32, 8, 2, 2, 2 proposals per particle (E_t^x with its fixed x-bits imposed and its + bits copied from E_{t-1}^x, exact weight 2^-f; row 19: one of the four patterns, weight 4 x 2^-f; row 20: bit 29 = E19[29]), the row and its two-bit conditions checked, multinomial resampling; tail: a variant drawn uniformly from 512 embedded variants of the 245,760 of the first 64 classes (its W8), 384 W23 proposals per particle drawn by importance sampling over the classes of its ten printed conditions (27 classes, probability (n + 2)/218, weight 218 x 2^-10/(n + 2)), W7 = W23 - s1(W21) - W16 - s0(W8) accepted iff in F7, W6 uniform, rows 22..37 computed and the outputs compared. Every success is rebuilt into a 38-step semi-free-start collision (inverse expansion, CV1 by inverting steps 7..0), verified (Lemma 4.1 returns W0..W13 of both members, equal outputs, rows -4..21 of the accepted event except W7's XOR cell) and run through the counted program step3b, which must accept it. Replicate trials return their first verified pair (CV1||M1, CV1||M1', 96 bytes each). Trial 20 returns a pair iff the pooled mean of the 20 linear estimates is >= 2^-98.4338 and no check failed. Trials 21..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Pass rule (frozen before the calibration): trial 20 returns a pair, i.e. pooled mean >= 2^-98.4338 with 0 failed checks. Returned pairs: 21 (one per replicate and trial 20). They are 96-byte CV1||M1 witnesses, each a 38-step semi-free-start collision from its CV1 (verifiable offline with the 38-step compression), NOT full collisions: the organizer recomputation finds 0 full collisions of the target here, by design. This experiment tests the q3 replica and the counted step3b program, not the complete two-block attack. Observations: log2_estimate, estimate_zero, successes, failed_rebuilds (failed checks, 0), other_pattern_successes (successes with an E19 pattern other than the published one), verified_pairs, tail_log2; trial 20: log2_pooled_mean. Calibration (960 local replicates, fresh labels, preregistered with the program hash): mean 2^-97.586, halves -97.590 / -97.582, the 48 pooled means of 20 have mean -97.600, standard deviation 0.201 bit, minimum -98.034, none below the threshold; 6,813 of 9,090 successes have another E19 pattern. Local emulation of the request: 21 pairs, pooled mean 2^-97.620. The replica estimates a lower bound of q3 (W23 classes never seen in development are not proposed); q3_model is 2^-97.7838.
